title: 创建您自己的3D漫画
prompt: A highly stylized 3D caricature of me, with expressive facial features, and playful exaggeration. Rendered in a smooth, polished style with clean materials and soft ambient lighting. Bold color background to emphasize the character’s charm and presence.
description: 使用Nano Banana Pro或Nano Banana Pro模型，轻松打造高度风格化的3D漫画形象，生动夸张的面部特征与流畅渲染完美结合，适用于个性化角色肖像和社交媒体展示，以大胆色彩背景凸显人物魅力。
